note: Once Human's full arsenal spans 126+ individual weapons (per oncehumandb.com) once every named legendary variant of each base chassis (DE.50, R500, MPS5/7, KV-SBR, SOCR, KAM, DB12/DBSG/ACS12, AWS.338, SN700, HAMR, MG4, KVD, etc.) is counted separately. The list above (72 entries) is a broad, sourced cross-section across all 9 weapon categories and every rarity tier — base chassis plus their notable named variants — rather than a literal enumeration of all 126+ entries; most of the gap is additional named legendary/epic skins of the same chassis already listed. One category is NOT under-represented by omission: Heavy Weapons genuinely only has a couple of carried options (MGL, RPG7 Rocket Launcher) in the live game — Gatling Cannons and plasma-round turrets are deployable structures, not carried weapons, so they are catalogued under Blueprints → Defense instead.
archetypeFieldNotice: Only a handful of named weapons carry a confirmedArchetype field: it means that specific weapon's own kit is independently confirmed to trigger that weapon-effect (e.g. SOCR - The Last Valor's built-in Shrapnel-style proc). Most weapons in Once Human don't have an intrinsic weapon effect at all -- Shrapnel, Power Surge, Frost Vortex, Bounce, Fast Gunner, Burn, Unstable Bomber, Fortress Warfare and Marked are granted by whichever core-effect mod you equip, and most mods fit most weapons in that slot. An earlier version of this database guessed a 'commonly paired' weapon effect for every weapon based on its category (e.g. 'pistols pair with Marked') -- that guess wasn't sourced and was removed after it was found to contradict a specific weapon's own confirmed ability. If a weapon has no confirmedArchetype, its specific weapon-effect synergy isn't confirmed by the sources used to compile this database -- browse the Mods section directly to pick one instead.
